sources.excerpt: Vemuram SHANKS ODS-1 | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Vemuram SHANKS ODS-1 SHANKS ODS-1 The Vemuram SHANKS ODS-1 is an easy-to-handle overdrive pedal created in collaboration with John Shanks, offering a wide range of tones for both studio and stage. It features controls for Level, Gain, and Tone/Bass, along with SAT trimmers, allowing for a versatile sound palette ranging from mild push to full-on distortion. Inspired by countless vintage pedals, the ODS-1 provides a perfect balance of overdrive and distortion. What Vemuram say about the SHANKS ODS-1 A collaboration pedal with John Shanks. An easy to handle overdrive with a wide range in tone. Equipped with two trimmers lets you control the Bass and the Saturation of the overall tone. Allowing you to achieve an even more wide variety to your ideal tone. Inspired by many countless vintage pedals. John Shanks Comment "We and the team at Vemuram have spent the last working and prototyping the new ODS-1 pedal. It’s a beautiful transparent overdrive that one can use to find that prefect balance of overdrive and distortion that I can use in the studio and on stage. The one go to that can cover most everything I need, from a mild push to full on for solos. A pedal I’ve been dreaming of for years that’s finally here." www.vemuram.com SHANKS ODS-1 compared to ...
